lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！
: 嗯呃……
计划失败了。

lines.en: Not only was I alone when I opened my eyes, but I wasn’t even in the place they likely closed in.
lines.zh: 不仅我睁开眼睛时是孤身一人，我甚至不在她们大概合上眼睛的地方。
于是，我又来到了这里。
这一次很轻松。

lines.en: I understood everything that was happening the whole way here.
lines.zh: 一路来这里的整个过程，我都明白在发生什么。

lines.en: And I understand everything now that I’ve arrived.
lines.zh: 而到了这里之后，我明白一切。

lines.en: The world is going to end.
lines.zh: 世界即将终结。

lines.en: But I am going to be okay.
lines.zh: 但我会没事的。

lines.en: Because there are still things that I have to do.
lines.zh: 因为我还有必须去做的事。

lines.en: And there is still something out there that wants to keep me alive.
lines.zh: 而且，外面还有某个东西，想要让我活下去。
这一点，我现在明白了。
神是真实存在的。
他只是抛弃了我们。
: 哦我的{b}天哪……{/b}
: Sensei……
: Sensei！

lines.en: : Who’s ready for a field trip back to roughly two months into the school year?
lines.zh: : 谁准备好来一场回到大约开学后两个月前的校外旅行了？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how long you’ve been gone?! I was worried sick!
lines.zh: : 你知道你消失了多久吗？！我担心死了！

lines.en: : I thought I’d never see you again! Where were you? Where did you go?! Why did you leave?!
lines.zh: : 我以为再也见不到你了！你去了哪儿？你去了哪儿？！你为什么要走？！

lines.en: : Was she like this when you couldn’t find {i}me{/i} as well?
lines.zh: : 当初你找不到{i}我{/i}的时候，她也是这副样子吗？
: 差得远了。

lines.en: : So it’s just you she’ll break down for. Got it.
lines.zh: : 所以只有你会让她崩溃。明白了。

lines.en: : How are you so calm?! You’ve been like this the whole time! I don’t get it! You love him too, don’t you?! Why aren’t you showing it?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么冷静？！你从头到尾都是这样！我不明白！你也爱他，不是吗？！你为什么不说出来？！

lines.en: : I’m calm because I’ve been through this more times than you could even imagine. One week is nothing.
lines.zh: : 我冷静，是因为这种事我经历过的次数，多得你根本想象不到。一个星期算什么。

lines.en: : A week? You two have been here for an entire week?
lines.zh: : 一个星期？你们两个在这里待了整整一个星期？

lines.en: : Yes. And kudos to Ayane for not breaking down until the fourth day. She was actually rather stable and mostly bearable beforehand.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且值得称赞的是，Ayane 直到第四天才崩溃。在那之前她其实还挺稳的，大体上还能忍受。

lines.en: : I’m sorry to hear that. I obviously didn’t mean to keep you waiting that long.
lines.zh: : 听到这个我很抱歉。我显然不是故意让你们等这么久的。

lines.en: : Just be happy the world hasn’t reset without you. Apart from that, I have some good news and bad news.
lines.zh: : 高兴点吧，至少世界没有在你不在的时候重置。除此之外，我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。

lines.en: : The bad news is, unfortunately, it appears that both of our new companions have been left behind. Of course, that can not be said {i}definitively{/i} given what happened last time, but still.
lines.zh: : 坏消息是，很遗憾，我们那两位新伙伴似乎都被留在那边了。当然，鉴于上次发生的事，这也不能{i}断言{/i}，不过还是。

lines.en: : It’s probably safe to assume they won’t be joining us.
lines.zh: : 大概可以安全地假定，她们不会加入我们了。

lines.en: : The {i}good{/i} news is that we did manage to learn that it {i}is{/i} possible for others to learn of the loops without any immediately negative consequences.
lines.zh: : {i}好{/i}消息是，我们确实弄清了：让其他人知道循环的存在，是{i}有可能{/i}不立刻招致负面后果的。

lines.en: : We still don’t know just what prerequisites are required to {i}get{/i} the others to a point like that, but we know now that it is possible. Progress has been made and a celebration is in order.
lines.zh: : 我们仍然不知道，要让其他人{i}达到{/i}那种状态究竟需要什么前提，但现在我们知道了那是可能的。进展已经取得，庆祝也该安排上了。

lines.en: : Or...will {i}be{/i} in order. I didn’t exactly pack a picnic this time and, even if I had, I’m sure none of the food would still be very edible.
lines.zh: : 或者……{i}将{/i}该安排上。这次我可没打包野餐的食物，就算打包了，我确定那些东西也早就不能吃了。

lines.en: : It’s really you...right? You’re not some memory-wiped replacement of Sensei that Maya conjured up to get me to stop crying?
lines.zh: : 真的是你……对吧？你不是 Maya 为了让我别哭，而变出来的、被抹掉了记忆的 Sensei 替身？

lines.en: : Just who exactly do you think I am?
lines.zh: : 你到底以为我是谁？

lines.en: : Someone who has {i}not{/i} made the last week very easy for me, that’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 一个绝对{i}没{/i}让上一个星期变得好过的人，这点倒是确定无疑。

lines.en: : Get a grip. If you really are going to become a regular member of our rooftop get-togethers, you’re going to have to get accustomed to...prolonged leaves of apocalyptic absence from time to time.
lines.zh: : 冷静点。如果你真要成为我们天台聚会的常客，你就得习惯……时不时来上一段长时间的「末日缺席」。

lines.en: : Of course, there’s no guarantee you’ll still be here once the world resets anyway, but I digress.
lines.zh: : 当然，世界重置之后你还会在不在这儿，这可没有保证，不过我扯远了。

lines.en: : Still holding onto your pregnancy theory even though Ayane made it here again despite an entire cycle of abstinence?
lines.zh: : 尽管 Ayane 在整整一个周期的禁欲之后还是回到了这里，你依然坚持你那个怀孕理论？

lines.en: : It’s not as if I surveyed you the entire time. You very well could have gone behind my back and created a secret child. I know exactly how insatiable the two of you are.
lines.zh: : 我又不是全程盯着你。你完全有可能背着我偷偷造了个孩子。你们两个有多欲求不满，我可是清楚得很。

lines.en: : But assuming I {i}do{/i} believe you, I’ll be holding onto my theory until the sun comes back up.
lines.zh: : 但就算我{i}真{/i}信了你，在太阳重新升起来之前，我还是会坚持我的理论。

lines.en: : Which could very well be any minute now that Sensei is-
lines.zh: : 既然 Sensei 已经——那随时都可能发生了。

lines.en: : What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？你们为什么这么看着我？

lines.en: : You need to learn to be more sensitive with other people’s feelings.
lines.zh: : 你得学会对别人的感受更体贴一点。

lines.en: : If I haven’t learned that trait by now, it’s probably safe to assume I’m either never going to, or...have just neglected to really {i}hone{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 如果到现在我还没学会这一点，那大概可以安全地假定，我要么永远学不会，要么……只是一直疏于{i}磨炼{/i}它。

lines.en: : I...am going to have...{i}so{/i} much sex next cycle. Just to spite you.
lines.zh: : 下一个周期我……要做{i}好多好多{/i}爱。就是为了气你。

lines.en: : I can’t help but be a little offended by that. I don’t think I’ve ever been used for revenge sex before.
lines.zh: : 这让我有点被冒犯到了。我不记得自己以前被人当作报复性性爱的工具用过。

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m so glad you’re back. This was somehow even worse than the first time I couldn’t find you — and that’s in no small part to understanding just what’s at stake now.
lines.zh: : Sensei……你回来我太高兴了。这一次甚至比我第一次找不到你时还难受——而很大程度上，是因为我现在明白了事关什么。

lines.en: : Next time the world is about to end, instead of a slumber party, I’m just going to tie myself to you. That way, you won’t be {i}able{/i} to get away and I won’t lose my very last bit of sanity.
lines.zh: : 下次世界要完蛋的时候，我不要办什么睡衣派对了，我直接把自己绑在你身上。这样你就{i}跑不掉{/i}，我也不会失去最后一丝理智。

lines.en: : Can you tell her to stop rambling on about the {i}next{/i} cycle when we still don’t technically know if-
lines.zh: : 你能不能让她别再念叨{i}下个{/i}周期了，我们严格说来还不知道——

lines.en: : Knock it off, Maya. There’s no harm in letting her be a little hopeful.
lines.zh: : 别说了，Maya。让她抱一点希望也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : If she’s going to have to get accustomed to “prolonged leaves of apocalyptic absence,” you’re going to have to get used to being wrong sometimes.
lines.zh: : 如果她得习惯「长时间的末日缺席」，那你也得习惯自己偶尔会错。

lines.en: : You don’t know everything anymore. You’re in the same exact boat as us. So stop trying to sound all knowledgeable and just figure shit out along the way like a real human.
lines.zh: : 你不再什么都知道。你和我们坐在完全同一条船上。所以别再摆出一副无所不知的样子，像个真人一样，一边走一边想办法吧。
: 哇哦。

lines.en: : We almost kiss {i}one{/i} time and now you think it’s okay to talk to me like I am inferior to you. Real nice.
lines.zh: : 我们才差点亲了{i}一次{/i}，你现在就觉得可以这么跟我说话，好像我低你一等。真有你的。

lines.en: : What part of the “same boat” do you not get? You’re not {i}inferior.{/i} You’re on the same level as us.
lines.zh: : 「同一条船」你有哪部分没听懂？你不是{i}低人一等{/i}。你和我们平起平坐。

lines.en: : I don’t think you understand how boats work. Boats have captains...crewmen...other...boat-people. They’re not all on the same level just because they’re on a single seafaring vessel.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不懂船是怎么运作的。船上有船长……船员……别的……船上的人。他们不会因为同乘一条航海的船，就都处在同一层级上。

lines.en: : Well, everyone on {i}this{/i} boat is on the same level. End of discussion.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}这条{/i}船上的每个人都在同一层级上。讨论结束。

lines.en: : I have a boat. I just can’t really get to it anymore on account of the wall.
lines.zh: : 我有一条船。只是因为那堵墙，我现在没办法走到它那儿了。

lines.en: : I said “end of discussion.” That means you too, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我说了「讨论结束」。这也包括你，Ayane。
: 明白。

lines.en: : I like the side of you that puts Maya in her place. Any time {i}I{/i} try to do that, she just makes me feel really bad about myself.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你能把 Maya 收拾得服服帖帖的那一面。每次{i}我{/i}想这么做，她都会让我对自己感觉糟透了。

lines.en: : I have not been {i}put in place.{/i} I just see no point in continuing to argue about a topic as stupid as boats when the world is about to end.
lines.zh: : 我可没有被{i}收拾{/i}。只是在世界即将终结的时候，继续争论船这种蠢话题，我觉得毫无意义。

lines.en: : It’s really weird that we’ve gotten to a point where sentences like that aren’t all that strange.
lines.zh: : 真够奇怪的，我们居然已经到了说这种句子也不觉得有多奇怪的地步。
: 是啊……
: 真的。
: 呜……可恶。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to stay mad at you when you look like that?
lines.zh: : 你这副样子，让我怎么继续生你的气啊？

lines.en: : This calls for a group hug! We can celebrate with that instead of a picnic.
lines.zh: : 这需要来个团体拥抱！我们可以用它来代替野餐庆祝。

lines.en: : Oh? Are you already forgetting that something like that is exactly how we get {i}out{/i} of this mess?
lines.zh: : 哦？你已经忘了吗，像那样的事，正是我们{i}脱{/i}困的方法？

lines.en: : Of course not. It just feels a little less formal if we’re doing it because we love one another and not because God likes watching people hug or something.
lines.zh: : 当然没忘。只是如果我们是因为彼此相爱才这么做，而不是因为上帝喜欢看人拥抱之类的，感觉就没那么正式了。

lines.en: : I couldn’t have said it better myself.
lines.zh: : 我自己可说不出这么好。

lines.en: : You definitely could have. That wasn’t my greatest line.
lines.zh: : 你绝对说得出来。那可不是我最棒的一句台词。
: 那是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: : Alright! Bring it in, everybody! Time for another field trip through time!
lines.zh: : 好了！都过来！是时候再来一场穿越时间的校外旅行了！

lines.en: : Wait, before we go back...there’s something I want to say.
lines.zh: : 等等，在我们回去之前……我有话想说。

lines.en: : Is it that you actually love me and that you’re only mean all the time because you’re putting on a brave face?
lines.zh: : 是说你其实爱我，而你总是这么刻薄，只是因为你在强装勇敢？

lines.en: : No. It’s that if I {i}am{/i} right and not having a child inside of you while doing this wipes your slate clean of all these memories, you are going to owe me dinner.
lines.zh: : 不。是说如果{i}我{/i}是对的，做这种事的时候肚子里没有孩子，就会把你这些记忆一笔勾销，那你就欠我一顿饭。

lines.en: : How will I even know that if I don’t have any memories of this?
lines.zh: : 可要是我对这一切都没有记忆，我怎么会知道呢？
: 那个我以后再想办法。

lines.en: : Can I say something as well?
lines.zh: : 我也能说点什么吗？
: 不能。

lines.en: : Go ahead, Sensei. I’ll listen to you.
lines.zh: : 说吧，Sensei。我听着。

lines.en: : I’m glad it’s you two I get to do this with.
lines.zh: : 能和你们两个一起做这件事，我很高兴。
: 换成别人都会觉得……不对劲。
: 大概因为那{i}本来就是{/i}不对劲。
: 我也要说！我也要说！
: 当世界重置的时候……
: 而我们{i}全都{/i}成功回来……

lines.en: : I don’t care {i}where{/i} we end up...
lines.zh: : 不管我们最后落到{i}哪里{/i}，我都不在乎……
: 但不管那是{i}哪里……{/i}

lines.en: : Know that I am going to tackle Sensei and proceed to make passionate love to him regardless of whether or not Maya is there.
lines.zh: : 要知道，我一定会扑倒 Sensei，然后和他热情地做爱，不管 Maya 在不在场。

lines.en: : Kay. Done. Send us home, Maya.
lines.zh: : 好啦。说完了。送我们回家吧，Maya。

lines.en: : After that? I’m not sure if I want-
lines.zh: : 在那之后？我不确定我还想不想——

lines.en: : I’m assuming you...still have all of your memories?
lines.zh: : 我猜你……还保留着全部记忆？
: 我明白了。
: Maya？
: 什么？

lines.en: : You might want to look away.
lines.zh: : 你也许该把头转开。
: 等等，你是认真的？！

lines.en: : Excuse me...teacher? I have a problem I need some {i}help{/i} with.
lines.zh: : 打扰一下……老师？我有一个问题需要{i}帮忙{/i}解决。

lines.en: : Hold on...you realize we’re still at school, right? Someone could come up here any-
lines.zh: : 等等……你意识到我们还在学校里吧？随时可能有人上——

lines.en: : Don’t care. Infinite world. Modifiable memory. Ayane do sex now.
lines.zh: : 不在乎。无限的世界。可修改的记忆。Ayane 现在就要做爱。

lines.en: : Maybe...it would be best if we waited until-
lines.zh: : 也许……我们最好还是等到——

lines.en: : Amamiya hidden technique — glomp of the midnight sun!
lines.zh: : Amamiya 家秘技——午夜太阳飞扑！
: Ayane，你他妈在干什么？！

lines.en: : What do you think you’re doing?!
lines.zh: : 你以为你在干什么？！

lines.en: : Something I should have done a {i}long{/i} time ago.
lines.zh: : 一件我{i}早该{/i}做的事。

lines.en: : Like, literally. I stopped having sex for an entire school year for no reason. I must now make up for lost time.
lines.zh: : 真的。我毫无理由地整整一个学年没做爱。我现在必须把失去的时间补回来。

lines.en: : How insatiable are you?! Couldn’t you have at least waited until I was gone?!
lines.zh: : 你到底有多欲求不满？！你就不能至少等我走了再说吗？！

lines.en: Ayane climbs on top of me and I am suddenly in a rather...uhh...well, you can see what type of situation it is.
lines.zh: Ayane 爬到我身上，我突然陷入了一个相当……呃……好吧，你能看出是哪种状况。

lines.en: : Did you miss me? Because {i}I{/i} missed you. And I am about to ride you so hard that your penis might break off. Sorry in advance.
lines.zh: : 想我了吗？因为{i}我{/i}很想你。我接下来要骑你骑得那么狠，你的阴茎说不定会断掉。提前说声抱歉。

lines.en: : At least give Maya a chance to-
lines.zh: : 至少给 Maya 一个机会——

lines.en: : Maya’s not going to leave now that she knows what’s going on. She’s going to stay here and yell and try to make us feel bad.
lines.zh: : Maya 现在知道发生了什么，就不会走了。她会留在这儿大喊大叫，拼命让我们觉得愧疚。

lines.en: : {i}Let her watch.{/i} I don’t even care.
lines.zh: : {i}让她看。{/i}我根本不在乎。

lines.en: : Yeah! You’re making that extremely apparent!
lines.zh: : 对啊！你还真是表现得一目了然！
: Ayane……别这样。

lines.en: : Oh, I will. I’m so fucking horny right now that I’ll probably cum the second it’s inside.
lines.zh: : 哦，我会的。我现在他妈的淫荡得要命，它一进去我大概就会高潮。

lines.en: She pulls her waist back and forth, slowly grinding against my dick- which is, as you may have guessed, extremely hard.
lines.zh: 她来回扭动着腰，慢慢在我的老二上磨蹭——而你大概也猜到了，它硬得要命。
: 然后……我会再高潮一次。
: 再一次。
: 再一次……再一次……再一次……

lines.en: : And we can keep doing that for the next several months or so until everybody disappears and I have finally had my fill.
lines.zh: : 接下来几个月我们都能这么干，直到所有人都消失，而我也终于吃饱了。

lines.en: She presses her body harder against mine...
lines.zh: 她把身体更用力地压在我身上……
: 说真的，停下！你他妈……好恶心！
: Ayane……
: 干嘛，[ayanemaster]？
: 我们……
: 我们晚点再做，好吗？

lines.en: : What?! Seriously?! But we’ve already waited so long!
lines.zh: : 什么？！认真的吗？！可我们已经等了这么久了！

lines.en: : Which is why a couple more hours shouldn’t be that much of a problem.
lines.zh: : 所以再多等几个小时，也不该是什么大问题。

lines.en: : If you’d have just looked away like I asked, there would be a penis inside of me right now! I can barely even remember what that feels like, Maya!
lines.zh: : 你要是刚才听我的把头转开，现在我里面就已经有一根阴茎了！我都快记不起那是什么感觉了，Maya！
: 呃……我……我很抱歉？

lines.en: Ayane pulls herself off of me and I have to awkwardly adjust myself so the following conversation doesn’t take place with an extremely large protrusion bulging out of my pants...
lines.zh: Ayane 从我身上爬下来，我尴尬地调整了一下自己，好让接下来的对话，不会在我裤子里顶着一个巨大凸起的情况下进行……

lines.en: : Do you not have the decency to fix yourself? You’re just going to stand here looking like that?
lines.zh: : 你就不能体面地收拾一下自己吗？你就要这么站着、那副样子？

lines.en: : I want Sensei to see what he’s missing.
lines.zh: : 我想让 Sensei 看看他错过了什么。

lines.en: : As if he hasn’t already memorized it...
lines.zh: : 好像他还没有把它背下来似的……
: 对不起，Ayane。只是——

lines.en: : I know exactly what it is. But that doesn’t mean I’m not going to be grumpy about it when I have been looking forward to this day for far longer than any girl should ever have to.
lines.zh: : 我完全知道那是什么。但在我盼着这一天、盼了比任何女孩都该盼的更久之后，我总该有资格发发牢骚吧。
: 哦，哭去吧你。

lines.en: : Sensei, you are to report directly to me the moment school is over. From that point on, I can not guarantee your safety.
lines.zh: : Sensei，一放学你就立刻来向我报到。从那一刻起，我就不能保证你的安全了。

lines.en: : Water and other refreshments will be provided, and a change of clothes will likely be necessary. Perhaps multiple.
lines.zh: : 会提供水和其他饮品，而且大概有必要换一身衣服。可能要换好几身。

lines.en: : I am going to go make preparations and leave you here. But please know that if you have sex with Maya {i}before{/i} me and this was all a coordinated effort on both of your behalves to shoo me away-
lines.zh: : 我要去做准备，先把你留在这儿。但请你明白，如果你在我{i}之前{/i}和 Maya 上床，而这一切是你们俩串通好把我支走的——
: 我会非常生气的！
: 就这样？这就是你的威胁？
: 而且我是认真的！

lines.en: : Thanks, Ayane. I really appreciate it and will report to you as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Ayane。我真的很感激，会尽快向你报到的。
: 你最好是这样！

lines.en: Ayane storms off, leaving me alone in the midst of an extremely awkward silence with someone who I may have just saved from permanent visual impairment and emotional trauma.
lines.zh: Ayane 气冲冲地走了，留下我独自面对一场极度尴尬的沉默——旁边那位，我大概刚刚让她免于永久的视觉损伤和情感创伤。

lines.en: : Ugh. I was really banking on that pregnancy theory. Now I have to deal with {i}this{/i} for the rest of forever. Wonderful.
lines.zh: : 唉。我本来真的把宝全押在那个怀孕理论上了。现在接下来整整一个永恒，我都得面对{i}这个{/i}了。太好了。

lines.en: : Was only a matter of time until you had to face the music. I don’t think any less of you for not being an expert on a concept no mortal would ever be able to grasp.
lines.zh: : 你迟早得面对现实。对一个任何凡人都无法理解的概念，你不是专家，我并不会因此看轻你。
: 我想你说得对。
: 谢了……帮我拦住她。

lines.en: : I didn’t believe she was actually going to go through with it. I’m used to people having a bit more...{i}tact.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没想到她真会做到那一步。我习惯的人都多少有点……{i}分寸{/i}。

lines.en: : Are you? Because you spend a lot of time with me and that’s sure as hell not a quality {i}I’m{/i} known for.
lines.zh: : 是吗？你可是花了很多时间跟我在一起，而{i}我{/i}绝对不以那种品质著称。

lines.en: : No, you’re certainly not. And it’s honestly a miracle that I’ve been able to deal with you for even half as long as I have.
lines.zh: : 不，你当然不以。说实话，我能忍受你这么久，已经是个奇迹了。

lines.en: : The same could be said for you. There aren’t many people who can face such constant beratement and {i}still{/i} wind up coming back for more.
lines.zh: : 你也一样。没多少人能面对如此不断的痛骂，却{i}依然{/i}还要回来受罪。

lines.en: : You’re right. It would take either a monster or the world’s most insidious pervert to waltz into such torment. Unsurprisingly, you are both of those things. I hope you’re proud of yourself.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。要么是个怪物，要么是世上最阴险的变态，才会大摇大摆地走进这样的折磨里。不出所料，这两样你都占了。我希望你为自己骄傲。

lines.en: : I get by. Having someone constantly reminding me of how horrible I am has actually done wonders in desensitizing me to my own wrongdoings. So thank you for that.
lines.zh: : 凑合过吧。有人不断提醒我有多糟糕，其实对我脱敏于自己的恶行大有裨益。所以谢了。

lines.en: : You’re welcome. I hope you die.
lines.zh: : 不客气。我希望你死。
: 彼此彼此。
: 我也担心了……
: 我知道。

lines.en: : Never disappear for that long again. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 别再消失那么久了。我是认真的。

lines.en: : It would have been fine for you to break down too, you know? You didn’t have to stay strong the whole time.
lines.zh: : 你其实也可以崩溃一下的，知道吗？你不必全程都撑着。

lines.en: : I got all of my crying out of the way on Christmas.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节那天，我已经把眼泪都哭完了。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine for a thousand more years.
lines.zh: : 再来一千年，我也没事。
这一天结束了。
但有别的东西开始了。
